text: My office has received communications from residents expressing concerns regarding traffic congestion and safety around the area of Castlefield Avenue and Avenue Road. The overwhelming demand for student drop-off and pick-up activity does not allow for parents to park for any length of time in the limited four parking spaces. Therefore, for maximum efficiency it must operate as a kiss and ride where parking is prohibited.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing 15-minute maximum parking limit on the north side of Castlefield Avenue, between a point 15 metres east of Avenue Road and a point 21.5 metres further east. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition, in effect at all times, on the north side of Castlefield Avenue, between a point 36.5 metres further east of Avenue Road and Yonge Street, to be in effect between Avenue Road and Yonge Street.
